audience: freelancers and teams that track billable time in Toggl Track

useCases.title: Check the timer that is running now
useCases.text: Read the running time entry, if one exists, with its start time and description.

useCases.title: Review last week's time by project
useCases.text: List your time entries for a date window, up to 1000 per call. List the projects to name each one.

useCases.title: Start a timer for a project
useCases.text: Read the running timer first. Then start a new timer for a project.

useCases.title: Stop the running timer
useCases.text: Read the running time entry, then stop it. Stopping an entry that already stopped returns an error.

useCases.title: Add a finished entry for past work
useCases.text: List the tags, then add a finished entry with a start time and a duration in seconds. Each call creates a new entry.
